items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: I never, I never heard Joe in person... Louis could get over his, his, his, his trumpet... I think Louis had the best tone.

ctx.x: How did Joe and, when the, when Louis Armstrong came up to join him, how did they compare? Was Joe was powerful, or more powerful, and Louis, or how?

Well, I never, I never heard Joe in person. Yeah, well, Joe was, uh, they, uh, Louis could get over his, his, his, his trumpet, and, and, uh, I don't know the, the, the playing, that playing was, was, uh, I don't know the, the, I don't know how to explain it, but it was a little different, but they were both good, but Louis was, was, uh, Louis was, was, uh, he could get over his trumpet, and, uh, fast fingering and all. Yeah, yes, uh-huh. And, uh, but Joe had a lot of, a lot of, uh, a lot of odd, sort of, uh,…
Uh-huh. I think it was. Did Joe use a lot of mutes, or derby, or what did he use?
